The check starts when Next.js calls `register()` in [src/instrumentation.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/instrumentation.ts) in the Node.js runtime. It registers event handlers and starts the in-process scheduler. In [scheduler.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts), `startScheduler()` calls `tick()` every minute; `tick()` enqueues the overdue job when its 60-minute cadence is due. `drain()` and `runHandler()` in [queue.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/jobs/queue.ts) dispatch it to `runOverdueIssueJob()`. A separate entry point, `POST()` in [route.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/app/api/cron/overdue/route.ts), checks the cron secret and runs the same job immediately.

`runOverdueIssueJob(now)` in [overdue-issue-job.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts) first verifies the live-only archive scope with `shouldFilterArchived()`. It asks `listOrgIdsForRollup()` in [usage-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts) for up to 50 organizations with usage records, ordered by oldest measurement. For each, `listOverdueIssues()` in [issue-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts) selects that organization’s unarchived issues whose due date is non-null and **strictly before** the supplied time, and whose status is `backlog`, `todo`, `in_progress`, or `in_review`. Results are ordered by due date.

For each result, the job emits `issue.overdue` with the organization, issue, project, due date and assignee IDs; it does not choose recipients or send notifications. Its module-level `reported` set skips issue IDs already announced and records an ID after `emit()` resolves, preventing repeat announcements during that process’s lifetime. This is not durable deduplication: a restart clears the set. Also, `emit()` in [event-bus.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/lib/event-bus.ts) isolates subscriber failures and resolves after reporting them, so an issue can be marked reported even if a notification subscriber failed.

The notification subscriber is attached when [event-registry.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/services/event-registry.ts) imports [notification-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/services/notification-service.ts). Its `issue.overdue` handler ignores unassigned issues; otherwise it calls `notify()` with only the assignee, an issue link, and a due-date message. `notify()` obtains that user’s organization- and kind-specific preference through `getPreference()` in [notification-preference-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/repositories/notification-preference-repository.ts). `resolveChannels()` defaults to `in_app` and `email` when no preference exists; for an explicit preference it includes enabled channels, with digest-only email subject to the `digest_email` flag. If no channels remain, no row is created. Otherwise, `insertNotifications()` in [notification-repository.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/repositories/notification-repository.ts) stores an unread row for that recipient and its selected channels.

The stored channel list is not itself an immediate email delivery. The separate `runDigestEmailJob()` in [digest-email-job.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/jobs/digest-email-job.ts) builds eligible subscribers’ digests at the organization’s configured UTC hour and calls `sendEmail()`; that function in [email-service.ts](/private/tmp/bench-scratch/3c5e70c7-3a3d-4d86-aacb-a43ff7a5400d/src/server/services/email-service.ts) currently logs the email rather than transmitting it.
